scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-size statements follow from the analytical path spectral decomposition and Brownian-bridge edge-space positive-semidefiniteness criterion. Exact rational finite assertions support, but do not replace, the proof; an independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem specifies an exact phase boundary and a full optimizer face at equality, but only compulsory positive closing conductance and strict gain below the boundary, not the full subcritical optimum. No discrete-time chains or asymptotic spectral-gap law for the auxiliary matrix are treated. Specialized historical equivalences cannot be ruled out.
title: A quadratic closing-edge price boundary and its full optimal face for fastest diffusion on cycles
